name: Orbital Economy v7.7 Construction Materials candidate r1
description: Regolith -> Construction Materials -> colonial Refinery/Electronics/Power expansion; Transport and energy use are intentionally unchanged.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Enabled
add_elements.description: v7.7 master switch: construction materials physically constrain colonial capacity expansion.

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Test 29 Regolith Shock Active] = 1, [A Regolith Base Extraction Capacity] * IfThenElse([A Test 29 Regolith Shock Applies] = 1, [v7.7 Regolith Shock Multiplier], 1), [A Regolith Base Extraction Capacity])

add_elements.description: Effective Regolith extraction capacity in colony A, including Mode 29 test wiring.
